description: This file contains implementation of shallow repository management functions for Git, including shallow file handling, commit graft registration, shallow commit retrieval, and reachability analysis.

methods.name: set_alternate_shallow_file
methods.description: Sets the alternate shallow file path for a repository, with validation.

methods.name: register_shallow
methods.description: Registers a shallow commit graft in the repository.

methods.name: unregister_shallow
methods.description: Removes a shallow graft from the repository by object ID.

methods.name: is_repository_shallow
methods.description: Checks if the repository is shallow based on shallow file presence and content.

methods.name: commit_shallow_file
methods.description: Commits the current shallow state to the shallow file and resets in-memory shallow info.

methods.name: rollback_shallow_file
methods.description: Rolls back shallow file changes and resets in-memory shallow info.

methods.name: get_shallow_commits
methods.description: Retrieves a list of shallow commits up to a specified depth.

methods.name: write_shallow_commits
methods.description: Serializes shallow commits into a buffer for writing.

methods.name: setup_temporary_shallow
methods.description: Creates a temporary shallow file with current shallow commits.

methods.name: setup_alternate_shallow
methods.description: Sets up an alternate shallow file with specified shallow commits.

methods.name: advertise_shallow_grafts
methods.description: Advertises shallow grafts over a network connection.

methods.name: prune_shallow
methods.description: Prunes shallow commits based on reachability and options.

methods.name: prepare_shallow_info
methods.description: Prepares shallow info structure by splitting commits into 'ours' and 'theirs'.

methods.name: clear_shallow_info
methods.description: Clears and frees resources in shallow info structure.

methods.name: remove_nonexistent_theirs_shallow
methods.description: Removes non-existent shallow commits from 'theirs' list.

methods.name: assign_shallow_commits_to_refs
methods.description: Associates shallow commits with refs based on reachability.

methods.name: delayed_reachability_test
methods.description: Performs a delayed reachability test for shallow commits.
